sourceState: Gallery keeps the complete original local Active Theory runtime, 31 project cards, authored assets, shaders, damping, scroll camera, and interaction code. The original SpineInstancer is hidden. The Demo Host's accepted close portrait Cortana renderer is composited as a fixed, non-interactive layer above the runtime with its original hologram materials and a frozen demand render loop, so the card system moves while Cortana remains stationary.
